review_candidates.title: Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: Role Overview We are looking for a Cloud Support Engineer with basic knowledge of Linux and cloud infrastructure to assist with day-to-day infrastructure operations, monitoring, troubleshooting, and user support. Key Responsibilities Provide first-level support for Linux servers and cloud infrastructure, and escalate complex issues to senior engineers. Perform basic Linux administration tasks such as checking server status, disk and memory usage, processes, services, logs, and file permissions.
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: The role is suitable for someone who has foundational knowledge and is willing to learn through hands-on work under the guidance of senior engineers. Practical lab experience, academic projects, or personal hands-on practice will also be considered. Required Skills & Knowledge 0 to 2 years of experience in IT support, Linux administration, system administration, or cloud support. Freshers with strong fundamentals and hands-on lab practice may also apply. Good to Have Hands-on exposure to OCI, AWS, Azure, or GCP through a job, internship, home lab, or training environment.
